review_description: Being retired solar specialist myself I have 2 systems producing more solar than required so that the f.i.t at the time of purchase covered the cost of my other utility - gas! The F.i.t . Reduced to just 6.7 cents so it was now time for a battery to power the house at night to cover the average draw of 7kW hours.I got the solution I needed from Amrut. After a 7 day delay of receiving full rebate confirmation from State Gov towards the cost, my battery and replacement hybrid was installed within 2 weeks. Including delay from Covid I had my system running within weeks of order. No deposit was required and I’m very impressed with their communication, their product knowledge, their perseverance , and installation tidiness.
